name: Bounce lobber
description: a brimstone demon of the Cracked Road: a hunched body of cracked black basalt with molten orange light glowing through every seam, short curved horns of charred stone, small burning ember eyes, a wide jaw with a furnace glow inside, squatting high, grey-brown dusty basalt, long rubbery arms, cradling a round glowing ball of magma in both hands

poses.stand: squatting on its haunches, the round glowing magma ball cradled in both long arms
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: squats, bouncing the glowing magma ball between its hands

attack.action: bounces the magma ball once off the ground, then throws it hard forward and down to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
